brief: Redesign the first screen of https://news.ycombinator.com so it reads faster and feels more desirable, keeping brand and copy.

judge.reason: This is the unchanged legacy HN list, functionally legible but visually dated, cluttered with no focal point and no redesign effort.

diagnosis: 물체 형태(LO)·움직임(MT) 반응이 낮음: 뚜렷한 사물 실루엣이 없는 텍스트 위주 화면
인지 통제(dlPFC)가 동원됨: 구조를 해석하는 데 노력이 듦
directives: Add one dominant object silhouette (product shape, device frame, bold geometric hero) or a diagonal that implies motion.
Lower effort: fewer choices on the first screen, consistent grid, one navigation level, clear reading order.
critique.prompt_block:
BRAIN CRITIQUE (TRIBE v2 predicted human cortex while looking at the last render; values are relative within this image):
- most driven regions: 보상·가치(OFC/vmPFC) +0.97, 인지 통제(dlPFC) +0.78, 장소·배경(PPA/RSC) +0.73; least: 1차 시각(V1–V4) -1.09, 움직임·형태(MT/LO) -2.13
- first-2s hook vs later: attention +0.62 → +0.57, visual drive -0.67 → -1.30
- areas the aesthetic head cites: ▼ 좌 전대상 24 (a24) [aesthetic]; ▼ 좌 후측 안와전두 보상 (pOFC) [aesthetic]; ▲ 1차 시각(V1–V4) 평균 [attention]; ▲ 움직임·형태(MT/LO) 평균 [attention]
- diagnosis: 물체 형태(LO)·움직임(MT) 반응이 낮음: 뚜렷한 사물 실루엣이 없는 텍스트 위주 화면 / 인지 통제(dlPFC)가 동원됨: 구조를 해석하는 데 노력이 듦
- DO NEXT (highest priority first): (1) Add one dominant object silhouette (product shape, device frame, bold geometric hero) or a diagonal that implies motion. (2) Lower effort: fewer choices on the first screen, consistent grid, one navigation level, clear reading order.
